title: Infernal Citadel
summary: A blackstone fortress on the Nether's lava sea. The Infernal Knight, the Magma Tyrant, and the Hellforged armour.

s.x: The Infernal Citadel is a blackstone fortress in the Nether, on stilts over the lava sea or built into a cliff. Its halls are lined with polished blackstone bricks, gilded blackstone, nether bricks and soul-fire braziers, with lava falls behind iron bars. It is the fifth dungeon and the first one outside the overworld. Its boss,
, drops the Tyrant's Core and the Hellforged scrap you need for the fire-proof Hellforged armour.
Lava is everywhere. Fire resistance, or fire immunity from the Hellforged armour, will save your life. Check your gear before you go through the Nether portal. See

The first floor is at about y 65, the second at about y 45, above the lava sea (y 31). Look for a blackstone fortress with banner towers.

A forecourt on stilts, then the gate hall: a causeway between two lava moats, columns, lava falls and arrow slits. The spine leaves by its north wall.
Three spine stages of halls: muster halls, barracks, war forges, lava bridges, a prison block and the chapel of flame.

Three spine stages: lava bridges, magma foundries, obsidian colonnades, imp warrens and an ember chapel.
